cocollective-cocollective:lever:b3a5c1ca.title: Senior Strategist
cocollective-cocollective:lever:b3a5c1ca.description: WHO WE ARE: co:collective is one of the world’s leading brand strategy and innovation consultancies. We’re led by our deep belief that today's most successful organizations are driven by an underlying purpose, one that is so central to their identity it influences everything they do, from capital investment to social media. For them, purpose becomes business strategy and storytelling becomes StoryDoing. At co: we design brands, experiences, and content for firms that transform who they are, how they act, and how they show up in the world, with the explicit goal of creating more StoryDoers. THE ROLE: Working alongside our Strategy team, you’ll have front-row access into our strategic development process, the activation of disruptive business and innovation concepts, and rigorous action recommendations, all aimed at helping our client’s embrace new Stories and embark on iconic Doing. WHO YOU ARE: A creative and strategic thinker who is really into culture, technology and people. A fun, genuinely open-minded collaborator who wants to apply their previous work experience and undergrad and/or MBA education into a nontraditional venture in the branding/innovation space. You are someone who is equally analytical and imaginative, with a passion for creativity and invention. You have the ambition of combining your professional experience and education with a desire for making capitalism kinder and the world better. WHAT YOU’LL DO: · Drive research to inform strategic recommendations: To get to great insights, we start with rigorous research. As a Strategist, you will work on studying and understanding markets, brands, culture, human behavior, among many other relevant themes, to drive strategic recommendations. · Contribute and learn from a multidisciplinary team: At co:collective you will be part of a diverse team (Client Engagement, Creative, Strategy, Technology) of “Story” and “Doing” mavens to develop strategies and creative solutions through collaboration. · Support client interaction: We believe in working together with our clients to devise awesome solutions. As a Strategist, you will participate in meetings, interview presentations, and co:llaboratory work sessions with clients. · Participate in business development: You will help identify, target, and develop opportunities that could lead to new project assignments for co:collective. Key activities will include research, sourcing, and co:ordination of strategy presentations. WHAT YOU’VE DONE: · 2-5+ years experience in relevant industries or environments, such as strategy or innovation consulting, client-side management, creative or marketing agency/consultancy. · Preferred, but not required: completed an MBA program and/or pursued an advanced degree in a personal passion field (we don’t look for a specific degree but do look for individuals who have a clear interest in innovation, design, brands, and solving meaty problems). · Demonstrated leadership capacity, collaboration skills, and tenacity: we value an entrepreneurial spirit and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get the job done. · Learned to synthesize large quantities of data (both qual and quant) to highlight actionable insights and resulting recommendations. · Worked under tight deadlines in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. · Refined your communication skills (both oral and written). WHAT ELSE? With great work, comes great reward! In addition to curating with a brilliant set of talented and passionate weirdos, we’re committed to creating an ever evolving progressive work environment. In addition to a salary commensurate with your experience, our perks include plenty vacation, performance-based bonuses, open seating and more snacks than you can imagine.

flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Pioneering Medicines: Senior Research Associate, In Vivo Pharmacology
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: What if... We could harness the power of Flagship’s scientific platforms and create novel treatment options that benefit more patients, sooner? Pioneering Medicines, a division of Flagship Pioneering, is building a world-class biopharmaceutical R&D capability focused on conceiving and developing life-changing treatments for patients by harnessing the power of Flagship's scientific platforms and applying those innovative approaches to serious diseases with unmet medical need. Unique to Pioneering Medicines’ approach is the opportunity to combine platforms to create truly novel and potentially transformative treatments. About Flagship Pioneering: Flagship Pioneering conceives, creates, resources, and develops first-in-category life science platform companies to transform human health and sustainability. Since its founding in 2000, the firm has originated and fostered the development of more than 100 scientific ventures, resulting in over $34 billion in aggregate value, 500+ issued patents, and more than 50 clinical trials for novel therapeutic agents. Position Summary : We are seeking a Senior Research Associate in the In Vivo Pharmacology group who will be responsible for independently developing and performing studies with animal models across multiple disease areas, including oncology, autoimmunity and metabolism. This individual will collaborate with in vitro biology, translational science and nonclinical groups to help execute on company strategy. Key Responsibilities: Support the screening, characterization, and mechanism of action studies for drug candidates of various modalities, including small molecules, biologics and nucleic acids Generate high quality data using in vivo models of oncology, autoimmunity and metabolism. Monitor animal health, accurately record data and comply with IACUC regulations in regard to animal welfare and care. Help develop ex vivo assays in conjunction with translational science to determine relevant pharmacodynamic biomarkers and mechanism of action of targets/programs within PM. Collaborate with colleagues within the larger in vivo group, in vitro biology, and translational teams to support PM’s daily operations in both the vivarium and the main laboratory. Basic Requirements: BSc or advanced degree in Biology or related disciplines with 2+ years of experience in animal handling within a research setting. Expertise in multiple forms of substance administration (e.g., PO, IP, IV, SC) Experience in necropsy, tissue collection and processing. Demonstrated ability to execute or learn various in vitro and ex vivo assays (e.g., cell culture, ELISA, Flow cytometry) Proficient in scientific software (e.g., Excel, GraphPad Prism, FlowJo) Ability to analyze scientific data and clearly communicate summarized data to internal PM team members and stakeholders. Accurately record detailed documentation of experimental results via ELN (Electronic Lab Notebook). Ability to operate as part of a team and work with colleagues across the organization to advance projects at all stages. Additional Qualifications: Research background in oncology, immunology, or metabolism in an industry or academic setting preferred. Previous experience with animal models of metabolism, oncology and autoimmunity preferred. Hands-on experience with flow cytometry is a plus. About Flagship Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. ghj-ghj:lever:be28380d-e093-4f22-b7ed-ad.description: GHJ Search & Staffing is partnered with a well-established professional services organization in Bakersfield to identify an experienced Senior Staff Accountant to join its accounting team. This is an excellent opportunity for an accounting professional who enjoys a broad, hands-on role and wants exposure beyond traditional general ledger accounting. The Senior Staff Accountant will support financial reporting, billing, accounts receivable, collections, cash management, and month-end close while working closely with leadership and other professionals throughout the organization. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable taking ownership of their responsibilities in a deadline-driven environment. This person will also have opportunities to identify process improvements and contribute to greater efficiency across the accounting function. Support financial reporting and month-end close activities. Prepare and review journal entries, reconciliations, and other accounting schedules. Assist with billing and accounts receivable activities. Monitor outstanding receivables and support collection efforts. Assist with cash management and related accounting activities. Maintain accurate financial records in accordance with GAAP. Research and resolve accounting and billing discrepancies. Manage multiple priorities while meeting established deadlines. Partner with members of the accounting team, leadership, and other professionals across the organization. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and operational efficiency. Learn and adapt to evolving accounting systems, technology, and business needs. Take on additional responsibilities as the position and organization continue to evolve. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a closely related field required. 4+ years of experience in accounting, billing, accounts receivable, collections, financial operations, or a combination of these areas. Strong understanding of GAAP and fundamental accounting principles. Proficiency with Microsoft Excel. Experience working with accounting, billing, ERP, or financial management systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Professional, collaborative, and team-oriented approach. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Willingness to learn new systems, receive feedback, and take on increased responsibility. Join a highly established organization with more than 70 years of history in the Bakersfield community. Broad accounting responsibilities offering exposure across multiple areas of the finance function. Supportive and collaborative work environment. Strong emphasis on work-life balance. Opportunities for professional development, advancement, and increased responsibility. Modern, well-designed office environment. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents. 401(k) plan with company contribution. Generous PTO, paid holidays, and additional employee programs and perks. #GHJSS #LI-MO1

jobgether-jobgether:lever:8d2e5299-6c47-.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8d2e5299-6c47-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Sweden. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins. 28

jobgether-jobgether:lever:d2108ece-fa77-.title: Financial Institutions Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobgether-jobgether:lever:d2108ece-fa77-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Financial Institutions Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Israel. This remote freelance opportunity is designed for finance professionals who want to apply their expertise to the development of advanced AI systems. You will help train and evaluate language models on complex financial institutions, regulatory, and risk-management topics. Your expertise will contribute to improving AI accuracy, reasoning, and understanding of real-world financial processes. The role involves testing models with realistic scenarios, reviewing their responses, and identifying gaps in financial and institutional reasoning. You will work independently while providing structured, evidence-based feedback that can influence future AI evaluation and training. Both experienced professionals and entry-level candidates with strong foundational knowledge and analytical skills are encouraged to apply. This is an opportunity to combine financial expertise with emerging AI technology in a flexible, fully remote environment. Challenge advanced AI models using scenarios and questions covering banking systems, financial regulation, capital markets, lending, compliance, risk management, and institutional governance. Evaluate model responses for factual accuracy, financial logic, regulatory interpretation, and consistency with real-world institutional practices. Assess AI reasoning across areas such as balance sheet analysis, credit risk, liquidity management, capital adequacy, AML controls, financial reporting, and macroeconomic policy. Identify and document model failure modes, errors, oversimplifications, and misunderstandings of financial regulations or institutional processes. Produce clear, reproducible error traces and structured feedback to support improvements in prompts, evaluation frameworks, and model performance. Apply strong analytical judgment to determine whether AI-generated conclusions are financially sound and appropriately supported. Clearly articulate reasoning and decision-making processes to help improve the depth, reliability, and usefulness of AI-generated financial analysis. Requirements: Knowledge of financial institutions, banking systems, financial regulation, capital markets, retail or commercial banking, central banking, compliance, risk management, lending, or related areas. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory. Professional experience in banks, credit unions, regulatory organizations, financial consulting, or similar institutions is highly valued. Entry-level candidates with solid foundational knowledge of financial systems and strong analytical capabilities are welcome. Strong understanding of financial concepts and the ability to assess complex institutional and regulatory scenarios. Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to explain analytical reasoning clearly and systematically. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle factual, logical, or regulatory inconsistencies. Comfortable working independently in a remote, project-based environment and adapting to evolving AI evaluation tasks. Benefits: Competitive freelance compensation: $6–$65 per hour, depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. Fully remote: Work from anywhere, with the opportunity to contribute to projects serving financial and AI applications globally. Flexible freelance engagement: Suitable for professionals seeking project-based work and candidates looking to apply their expertise in a new technological context. AI and finance exposure: Gain hands-on experience contributing to the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems. Meaningful impact: Help improve AI systems' ability to understand financial institutions, regulations, risk, and complex decision-making. No traditi

southparkcommons-render:ashbyhq:d52dc923.description: At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. APPLYING TO RENDER We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. We are scaling rapidly. Our customers have created hundreds of thousands of services on our platform, and the numbers continue to accelerate. Our customers trust us to deliver a secure, reliable and performant cloud — this is our top priority as a company. By joining us at an early stage, you will design and build the cloud platform you've always wanted for yourself, and make decisions that will shape our product and company, directly impacting developers around the globe. We are looking for engineers with deep specialization in cloud infrastructure. We are particularly interested in experience with container orchestration, low-level networking, and storage management.
